name: Kudou Kanae
source: Kanae is the student of Kazami affiliated junior high class 3-1 and part of a trio with [url=/c4020]Jun'ichi[/url] and [url=/c4019]Suginami[/url], and a good friend of [url=/c4014]Kotori[/url]. [spoiler]While being a girl, she keeps up a male appearance to attend school under her grandmother's instructions. Only Kotori and several teachers including [url=/c4021]Koyomi[/url] know of her true gender. She is always absent during physical checkups to prevent her gender being found out.[/spoiler] Originally only mentioned by last name in the first game as a sub-character with no dialogue.
